notes: UX-30.5 administration layout is verified. Other UX-30 criteria retain partial evidence; this does not establish the full route/state, browser, physical-device or human-review matrix.

Current final initial loading uses a static operations skeleton. Header, H1, navigation and Refresh geometry match the loaded view exactly at 390px. Earlier admin-initial-loading-phone measured a shell fallback, and admin-initial-operations-loading-phone reproduces the overflow fixed afterward; neither is final proof.

admin-refresh-retry-observed-phone was sampled after completion. Use admin-final-refresh-pending-phone for actual pending evidence. Do not compare scroll-relative coordinates across different scrollY values as layout movement.

admin-restaurant-save-failed-phone is historical: it predates removal of the duplicate global error. The final failure image and explicit alert check verify only the local error remains and budget 21 is preserved. The real isolated fixture saved 21 successfully and was restored to 20.

Email values are not exposed by this browser DOM/AX accessor. Empty/null value samples cannot establish data loss or preservation. The three pending-invite screenshots visibly preserve pending-review@restaurant.test before refresh, after a 503, and after successful retry. No invitation was created; the field was cleared afterward.

Final food-report layout uses 44px shared action links. The screenshot retains an earlier in-memory Unsaved changes label; source now says Reply not sent on a new edit. No report reply, resolution or allowance restoration was submitted.

Availability pilot selection and look search were exercised without saving. Reverting to open clears dirty feedback. All 65 current and legacy admin look options remain available; this is distinct from the 56-style consumer browser.

Populated and empty admin responses include controlled local fixtures. Anonymous/owner GETs and owner mutation are denied with 403; admin reads return 200. Existing account invitation/reset actions were not executed, and recovery integration remains deferred.

Temporary response rules were cleared, gateway stopped, and browser returned to localhost:5173. No production data, paid generation, purchases, deployment, outbound message or human session was performed.
